host_partition.canonical_host_id: Expand scientific-notation text as an exact decimal integer without conversion through floating point. This cannot recover precision already lost upstream.
host_partition.usage: Benchmark hosts supply the common cutoff only and are excluded from all model training, OOF evaluation and sensitivity analysis pools.

benchmark_development.scope: Primary listing eligibility within the final primary analysis cells. Benchmark hosts supply the common cutoff only and are excluded from every model fit, OOF prediction and sensitivity sample.

threshold_definition: Compute the pooled benchmark-development P75 once; hold the resulting integer cutoff fixed across all segments, models and sensitivity samples. Analysis-pool outcomes do not determine this cutoff.
exploratory_status: This revised design follows prior exploration of the supplied snapshot. Computational separation does not create a previously untouched final test or remove the influence of earlier research choices.
validation_definition: Revised exploratory five-fold host-grouped cross-validation, with a computationally separate benchmark-development host partition. No independent untouched final test set or hyperparameter search.
scope_support_definition: Apply all eligibility filters and remove benchmark hosts, then retain segments with at least 50 analysis listings. Benchmark rows must satisfy primary eligibility and belong to these retained primary segments.
ranking_intervals: 95% percentile intervals from 500 within-segment host-cluster resamples, conditional on existing OOF probabilities; models are not refitted and intervals exclude model-fitting and model-selection uncertainty.
established_definition: First review on or before 2025-06-01, using reference date 2026-06-01. This is a review-history criterion, not listing launch date or proof of continuous operation.
main_model_interpretation: Physical listing attributes associated with review activity in the preceding year, evaluated on held-out analysis hosts. These are not verified pre-opening measurements or forecasts of a new operator's next year.
operating_controls_sensitivity: Current quoted price and minimum stay are contemporaneous operating characteristics, included only as a separately labelled sensitivity.
calibration_status: No post-hoc calibration is fitted. ECE uses ten fixed equal-width bins; sparse high-score bins limit calibration interpretation.

provenance.limitation: Raw CSV files are unavailable. Cached cleaning features are reused; raw parsing, original identifier precision and review-date reconstruction have not been revalidated.

raw_review_validation.reason: Raw listings, review dates and per-listing scrape dates are required; they are not all available.
